Better: param "n" int8; guard = ["ge", ["var","n"], ["const","I", threshold]] with threshold = i → each run with a different n enables a different prefix set of transitions → distinct masks ✓ (since transitions are ordered by threshold). That's a realistic monotone family; distinct masks for each of 256 n values ✓.

Runs: n = 0..255 → each run's enabled set = transitions with t ≤ n → distinct masks ✓.

Note: with n=0, only transitions with t=0 enabled (1/256 of 16384 = 64 transitions) — might be unreachable; fine, that's the worst case for Dijkstra scanning.
